identitySync.description: Synchronise mailbox groups and disable sign-in for accounts removed or disabled at the identity provider. Mail delivery remains enabled.
identitySync.idChangeBody: Existing LDAP identity IDs will be cleared. The next login or sync will link these mailboxes again by email address. Offboarding markers are retained.
identitySync.idHelp: Leave empty to use objectGUID, entryUUID, nsUniqueId, ipaUniqueID or the distinguished name.
identitySync.limitHelp: Percentage of active accounts or memberships that one run may remove. Mailcow allows at least five mailboxes. Preview changes before forcing a blocked run.
identitySync.pathsHelp: Comma-separated paths, for example /staff, /teams/* or /* for all groups.
identitySync.runConfirmation: Apply the configured synchronisation. This may create mailboxes, change group membership or disable sign-in.
identitySync.forceConfirmation: Apply synchronisation while bypassing the offboarding and membership-removal limits. Review the preview before continuing.
identitySync.forceAcknowledge: I understand that this run can disable sign-in for many accounts and remove group memberships.
identitySync.queued: Requested. Mailcow will process this run on its next cron cycle.
identitySync.noSummary: The run has no result yet.
identitySync.blockedHelp: The change limit stopped this run. Review the proposed changes and conflicts before requesting a forced run.
identitySync.linksHelp: Inspect a mailbox’s stable external identity. Clear a link only when the mailbox should be linked to a different provider account.
identitySync.unlinkBody: Clear the identity link of {mailbox}? The next login or sync can link this address to a different provider account. A disabled mailbox remains disabled.
identitySync.noLink: No identity link is stored for this mailbox.

sectionHelp.directory: Identify directory users consistently and recognise disabled accounts.
sectionHelp.offboarding: Control what happens when users are disabled or removed at the provider.
sectionHelp.groups: Synchronise provider groups with mailbox groups and choose how new groups are created.

help.groupBaseDn: Leave empty to use the user base DN.
help.groupFilter: LDAP filter selecting the groups to synchronise, for example (&(objectClass=group)(cn=mailcow-*)).
help.groupNameAttribute: Attribute containing the group name, usually cn.
